attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23), persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance by writing /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf with net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_redirects=0 and net.ipv4.conf.{all,default}.accept_source_route=0, applied at runtime with `sysctl -p`, and confirmed the OpenRC `sysctl` service (boot runlevel) loads /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf on startup. Verified persistence by rebooting node1 via the native `reboot` command, confirming a changed kernel boot_id (d0fcb49d... → 8b9e7b1c...) and reconfirming all four sysctl values remained 0 and networking (eth0) was healthy post-restart.
